name: Poly Property Services Co., Ltd.
summary: Poly Property Services Co., Ltd. and its subsidiaries manage properties in China, formerly under the name Poly Property Development Co., Ltd. Services cover residential communities under brands such as Oriental Courtesy and Harmony Courtyard, commercial and office buildings under Nebula Ecology, and public services. It also provides pre-delivery support for developers, community services for owners like home furnishing and parking agency, and office leasing.
